name: autospread
description: A lightweight bilingual growth operating system for agents: diagnose constraints, choose playbooks, act within autonomy policy, and verify outcomes.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose the biggest product-growth constraint, choose the smallest useful playbook, execute with connected tools inside an autonomy policy, and verify business outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Use AutoSpread to audit this product, identify the largest growth constraint, and propose the smallest evidence-driven next experiment.
